items.text: No practice again for Saquon Barkley (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited practice. Eagles injury report Thursday.
items.why: Hamstring issues for both; Smith progress but Barkley still out of practice.
items.implication: Barkley game-time or OUT risk high with Hurts also out; Smith trending better but monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: If Barkley OUT, next RB (Pierce/Shipley context) gets goal-line/carries; Smith limited reduces WR1 upside.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee), and S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel to London and are ruled OUT vs Jaguars.
items.why: Will not travel; confirmed by Schefter on Montgomery/Pitre.
items.implication: Full snaps/opportunity to next Texans RB (Marks lead); Dell absence boosts other HOU WRs.
items.opportunity: Carries and targets free up in London game; PPR upside for backup RBs via catches vs strong Jags run D.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled out indefinitely with superficial blood clot in calf; Tanner McKee to start vs Panthers. Possibly without Barkley and Smith as well.
items.why: Superficial blood clot; medical situation unresolved per Rapoport corroboration.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade; Eagles implied total drops sharply; McKee unproven starter.
items.opportunity: Pass volume may shift to Goedert/Wicks if Smith limited; avoid most Eagles skill if possible.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return with shoulder injury in TNF vs Seahawks, then returned to the game and finished ACTIVE.
items.why: Shoulder; cleared and returned after Q designation.
items.implication: Played through; reverse any stale sit/beneficiary calls from mid-game Q.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets restored post-return; no lasting snap loss confirmed.
items.conflict: Berry hated Waddle pre-game on matchup.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore did not practice for second straight day due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Elevated OUT/GTD risk; monitor for volume to other BUF WRs.
items.opportunity: Targets free if limited/out; third-down/two-minute usage at stake.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love did not practice for second straight day due to ankle injury.
items.why: Ankle; also noted as run-down; may rest.
items.implication: High OUT risk; Allgeier or committee next up in tough matchup.
items.opportunity: If OUT, backup RB flex upside via carries; monitor Friday designation.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty (foot/ankle) full practice, feels great and ready to go; coach confirms playing vs Bills, ankle off report. Positive trend after prior Q concerns.
items.why: Full participation; Kubiak: playing, feeling better; self-report ready.
items.implication: Low-end RB1 locked in; reverse rest rumors.
items.opportunity: Full carries/routes expected; no pitch count indicated.

items.text: RB snaps in two full games since Breece Hall injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0. Hall week-to-week, no practice.
items.why: Clear lead to Allen on snaps; Hall remains week-to-week.
items.implication: Allen handcuff/lead locked while Hall out; start Allen confidently.
items.opportunity: Near-monopoly snaps/carries/routes for Allen; reverse if Hall unexpectedly active.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins/McNabb/McCoy/Ertz). Saquon turns 30 in Feb; if contender with RB need, call now. Worth risk of year-too-early vs too-late.
items.why: Age cliff + Eagles precedent; current hamstring adds urgency.
items.implication: Sell-high window if contending; ROS risk elevated beyond injury.
items.opportunity: Role still elite when healthy but age/usage wear; monitor snap share post-return.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders defense buffet for pass catchers.
items.why: Soft WSH defense nightmare for WRs; high usage expected.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; stack with Kittle/Purdy possible.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) on bankable usage; Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) on elite recent usage and leaking run D. Also Javonte Williams @GB (RB8) goal-line role and Rhamondre Stevenson vs NYJ (RB9) volume.
items.why: Usage you can bank on for London; volume + matchup for RBs; Kyren elite snaps, Javonte GL, Rhamondre volume (Henderson multi-week context).
items.implication: Priority starts; Rhamondre top-12 upside if Henderson limited.
items.opportunity: Carries/targets/red-zone confirmed leans; Stevenson volume secure.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) on ugly matchup; Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34) shaky QB/feed; Kyle Pitts vs CHI (TE18) limited targets. Also hates Woody Marks, JK Dobbins, Bo Nix, Justin Herbert.
items.why: Tough defenses, low volume/QB issues, poor implied totals.
items.implication: Sit/fade; Waddle matchup risk even post-ACTIVE.
items.opportunity: Low projected snaps/routes/targets relative to alternatives.

items.text: Loves Brock Purdy vs WSH (QB2) and George Kittle vs WSH (TE3); high-scoring vs pass D that can't stop. Also likes Stafford/Love QBs in shootouts. Caleb Williams full practice positive.
items.why: WSH defense buffet; game environment/totals; Caleb full practice return path.
items.implication: Purdy/Kittle stack strong; Caleb QB8 watch if cleared.
items.opportunity: Pass volume/red-zone to Kittle; Caleb full snaps if plays.

items.text: Round 3 rookie Ja'Kobi Lane generated huge offseason buzz, legit shot to ice Bateman. Returns from wrist surgery to elite 6.4 YPP offense (even w/ Lamar missing snaps); shot to play this weekend.
items.why: Camp buzz + full practices; HC shot to play; offense efficient.
items.implication: Stash/deep league add; potential Bateman/ Flowers competition or flex.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets available in Ravens WR room with injuries; monitor snap share on return.
